pendingNotices.details: This resolves at the END of the Command phase, once both players have passed. You'll then choose to either move up to 5 units from one system to the Rebel Base (ignoring adjacency) or establish a new Rebel Base.

pendingNotices.title: Rapid Mobilization — units moved to base
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player moved 1 unit from Dagobah into the hidden Rebel Base. The base itself did NOT move — Rapid Mobilization's other option (establish a new base) was not used, so no probe card changes hands and Dagobah remains a possible base location.

pendingNotices.details: Death Star Plans needs at least 1 of your FIGHTERS (X-Wing, Y-Wing or U-Wing) still alive when the space battle step ends.
